answer.answer: Three programmes support micro-enterprises and livelihoods through distinct financial mechanisms: (1) PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) [E01] provides collateral-free working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and digital transaction cashbacks to formalize street vendors [E02]; (2) Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) [E03] is a credit-linked subsidy scheme that generates employment by supporting establishment of new micro-enterprises in rural and urban areas through margin money subsidies and backward/forward linkages [E03]; and (3) Both schemes use interest subsidies and credit support—PM SVANidhi offers guarantee cover (31.87% for 1st tranche, declining for subsequent tranches) [E02], while PMEGP allocates margin money subsidies from annual budgets for new micro-enterprises and upgradation of existing units [E03].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PM SVANidhi provides collateral-free working capital loans up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and digital transaction cashbacks to street vendors
PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy scheme supporting establishment of new micro-enterprises through margin money subsidies
PM SVANidhi offers guarantee cover ranging from 31.87% for 1st tranche to 6% for 3rd tranche
